cases.name: channels given as results: each curve fitted through them, with the worked math and a 30% range
cases.source: Nov 25, 2026 competitive review: results input (fitted), months, showMath, rangePct
stdout: AAJ Paid Media Budget Allocator — your channels only
Mode: budget  ·  Diminishing returns: moderate (0.8, AAJ's default)
Channel            Spend     %  Per day  Customers      CAC  Marg.CAC  BaseCAC
From results (each curve is fitted through the channel's own monthly spend and customers):
Google: $12,000 a month for 21 customers ($571 each). Base CAC at low spend $496. CPC $5.71, click-to-lead 8.0952%, lead-to-customer 12.3529%.
LinkedIn: $6,000 a month for 10.98 customers ($546 each, 3 months averaged). Base CAC at low spend $474. CPC $11.54, click-to-lead 11.7308%, lead-to-customer 18%.
Capterra/G2: $2,700 a month for 7 customers ($386 each). Base CAC at low spend $341. Cost per lead $90.00, lead-to-customer 23.3333%.
Meta: $4,000 a month for 9 customers ($444 each). Base CAC at low spend $429. CPC $0.95, click-to-customer 0.2143% (no lead stage given).
✓ LTV:CAC is above 3:1, David Skok's SaaS reference point (paid-media CAC only).
Pacing: $4,605 a week and $658 a day in total (month ÷ 30.4, the average days in a month, as Google Ads counts a monthly limit).
Range: every channel's cost per customer 30% lower or higher than entered (a what-if, not a forecast).
This budget buys 61.8 to 33.3 customers, at a blended CAC of $324 to $601.
How each number is worked out (figures rounded for display)
Cost per lead  $5.71 a click ÷ 8.0952% click-to-lead = $70.59
Base CAC       fitted to $12,000 a month for 21 customers: ($30,000 cap ÷ (21 × 0.8)) × ln(1 + 0.8 × $12,000 ÷ $30,000) = $496
Cost per lead  $11.54 a click ÷ 11.7308% click-to-lead = $98.36
Base CAC       fitted to $2,700 a month for 7 customers: ($8,000 cap ÷ (7 × 0.8)) × ln(1 + 0.8 × $2,700 ÷ $8,000) = $341
Cost per lead  $0.95 a click ÷ 0.2143% click-to-customer (no lead stage given) = $444.42
Base CAC       fitted to $4,000 a month for 9 customers: ($45,000 cap ÷ (9 × 0.8)) × ln(1 + 0.8 × $4,000 ÷ $45,000) = $429
